tier1.text: Each precentral gyrus is the primary motor cortex, the area that starts movements. Its cells tell the spinal cord to move skeletal muscles, which attach to bones. Each precentral gyrus controls movement on the opposite side of the body. The precentral gyrus is the rearmost part of the frontal lobe, the brain's front region.

quotes.quote: The precentral gyrus is the primary motor cortex. Cells from this region of the cerebral cortex are the upper motor neurons that instruct cells in the spinal cord to move skeletal muscles.
quotes.citation: Betts JG, Young KA, Wise JA, Johnson E, Poe B, Kruse DH, Korol O, Johnson JE, Womble M, DeSaix P (2022). Anatomy and Physiology 2e. OpenStax.

quotes.quote: skeletal muscle tissue: forms skeletal muscles, which attach to bones and control locomotion and any movement that can be consciously controlled
quotes.citation: Clark MA, Douglas M, Choi J (2018). Biology 2e. OpenStax.

sentences.text: Each precentral gyrus controls movement on the opposite side of the body.

quotes.quote: Motor commands from the precentral gyrus control the opposite side of the body, whereas sensory information processed by the postcentral gyrus is received from the opposite side of the body.
quotes.citation: Betts JG, Young KA, Wise JA, Johnson E, Poe B, Kruse DH, Korol O, Johnson JE, Womble M, DeSaix P (2022). Anatomy and Physiology 2e. OpenStax.

sentences.text: The precentral gyrus is the rearmost part of the frontal lobe, the brain's front region.

quotes.quote: The most posterior region of the frontal lobe, the precentral gyrus, is the primary motor cortex.
quotes.citation: Betts JG, Young KA, Wise JA, Johnson E, Poe B, Kruse DH, Korol O, Johnson JE, Womble M, DeSaix P (2022). Anatomy and Physiology 2e. OpenStax.

quotes.quote: The frontal lobe is located at the front of the brain, over the eyes.
quotes.citation: Clark MA, Douglas M, Choi J (2018). Biology 2e. OpenStax.
